thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2026-03-20. Commit: d4f3c2b. Canary: passed (us-west). Rolling to eu-west and ap-southeast now. Release notes: https://intra.redwood/release/2026-03-20 :rocket:
maria: saw canary results, looks green on latency and error rates. starting smoke checks for eu-west now.
aj: thanks — I'll watch the synthetic dashboards. tagging @sasha in case of model variant regressions.
sasha: ack, joining. quick note: eu embed probe historically spikes on cold warmstart; will validate kv-cache warmup.
maria: eu-west smoke output (first 30s):
```
200 OK   model/embeddings  p95=45ms p99=120ms
200 OK   chat/generate     p95=210ms p99=520ms
503     embed-synth      errors=3/200   
```
maria: 3 x 503s from embed-synth, all to node eu-west-2c, same host id.
kevin: I see related logs, host eu-west-2c reported OOM on tensorcache during warmup and restarted the runtime.
aj: was that during the canary?
maria: canary was us-west only, eu-west is in rolling stage so not part of canary.
kevin: runtime restarts triggered the 503s. looks like quantized model variant triggered larger memory usage.
sasha: what's currently deployed on that host? model v2-quant-8bit?
maria: yes, v2-quant-8b pinned for this rollout.
aj: options: 1) pause eu-west rollout and pin to v2-quant-4bit (lower mem), 2) roll back eu-west hosts to previous runtime build, 3) evict problematic AZ and continue. Thoughts?
kevin: quickest is pause and pin to 4bit variant for eu-west. rollback runtime would slow global rollout. evicting AZ needs infra approval.
sasha: agree with pause+pin. We should also add a temporary rule in routing to avoid 2c host until infra reprovisions.
oncall-bot: Incident tentative: INC-2026-03-20-01 created for eu-west embed synthetic failures. Pager silenced to oncall for now.
maria: I'll pause the staged rollout (deploy-bot pause) and update rollout config to pin eu-west to v2-quant-4bit.
maria: /deploy pause release/2026-03-20 --scope=eu-west
maria: updated rollout: eu-west pinned -> v2-quant-4bit, notes added to release: "eu-west: pin model variant after embed-synth OOMs; follow-up: infra to repro and increase host mem or use different runtime flags."
aj: adding observability task: capture heap profile on next repro, and add synthetic to run longer warmup (30s) before traffic.
kevin: infra will repro in a sandbox. I'll coordinate with infra to repro OOM and test 8bit variant with increased memory.
sasha: will file a small telemetry check to detect early KV cache growth next time.
maria: can we get a quick post-deploy status? new synthetic run (after pin) 2m later:
```
200 OK   embed-synth      p95=68ms p99=140ms  errors=0/300
200 OK   chat/generate     p95=230ms p99=510ms  errors=0
```
maria: eu-west looks stable after pin. resuming rollout to ap-southeast?
aj: hold for 10m while infra finishes repro and confirms host replacement plan. then resume.
kevin: infra says they will repro by EOD and increase host mem on next batch; for now we can continue outside 2c.
sasha: logging note: add a follow-up to release notes: "Investigated embed-synth 503s in eu-west due to runtime OOM on quantized variant; pinned eu-west to 4bit variant while infra remediates."
maria: done in release notes and in the changelog link. closing thread once rollout resumes. :white_check_mark:
